Game Overview

In Grench vs Santa, the core idea is straightforward: race against a friend in the festive showdown of Grench vs Santa. Outpace your opponent as you dodge obstacles, snatch gifts, and secure your stash. With pixel art charm and heart-pounding speed, this exhilarating holiday challenge will crown the fastest gift gatherer. Ready, set, go!
